about: Caption registry (CONTRACT 6.2, 6.5): the three result labels and the captions a result may carry, as exact strings. js/widgets/labels.js embeds the same strings in its CONFIG; verification/check_states.mjs checks that both agree with each other and with CONTRACT.md, and that every marked element on screen shows one of them.

family_form.about: The screen form of the family slot (I-02). The text form is the engine name (result.family.name, 𝒜_≤3), so a label's textContent equals the registry string with that name in the slot. On screen every low line and the run after it (up to a space or a parenthesis) are drawn as a hidden low line (an aria-hidden element with low_class, hidden by base.css) and a <sub> element with sub_class holding the run: 𝒜_≤3 is 𝒜<sub>≤3</sub>, 𝒜_q (𝒜_≤3) is 𝒜<sub>q</sub> (𝒜<sub>≤3</sub>). A name without a low line (𝒜₆, 𝒜ᵨ,≤3) is written as it is. The slot in words (pages before G-04) is plain text. Examples: notation/notation.yml label_form.
